AudioRef.description: The uploaded audio of a project, as the server stored it.
AudioRef.title: AudioRef

Generation.description: Progress of the app's own prompt writer (promptgen.py): all prompts after the analysis approval, or one prompt.
Generation.title: Generation

post.description:
Writes what is still missing: the scene plan when it does not exist yet (transcript and cut points are ready), else the prompts of the approved
analysis. Also the retry after a failure: it never starts a second job.
Writes a new text for this one prompt in the background (the progress is in /review "generation"); other prompts are not touched.

get.description: Quality checks measured on the rendered video of this aspect (a missing video is one failed check, not an error).
The user's decision about the rendered video of this aspect: none, approved, or fixes requested (with the issues).

put.description: Approve the video (refused while a QC check has failed) or request fixes (the issues are kept).

post.description: match = ingest + match (no render); timeline = ingest, match, gate, fill, validate (no render); preview / final = the existing build chain for the chosen aspect.
